title: ze_Boatescape888
description:
Test!Port from csgo, currently contains 16 maps ending and 1 original ending.
The error: "CUtlRBTree overflow with 65535 elements" is a problem with CS2 itself, need Vavle to fix.
Due to high speed laser or ball has no damage, so the speed of ball or laser in aware and realm is 5700(previously is 6000).
The damage of realm and aware is 50hp one hit.
The damage in mgden is, green ball 50hp one hit, blue ball is 100hp one hit(death).
The falling heart of arcana heart is not solid, it caused damage by trigger_hurt, do not touch the side.
Type the following text in console in local game, then you can get map god in local game, need sv_cheats 1.
ent_fire !self SetDamageFilter Map_CT_God
